name: SPLIT and JOIN
desc: SPLIT expression, JOIN expression, and SPLIT action: literal and longest-match regex separators, zero-width progress, retained separators, element constraints, Unicode boundaries, trimming order, scoped operands, nested edits, and separator/trimming metadata across reassembly. Supporting actions expose intermediate arrays and metadata without prescribing an implementation, traversal order, or resource-counter totals. Static diagnoses are allowed where the specification permits them.

Default evaluation and ignoring
tests.desc: When sep is a regex, default is evaluated as a value and must return a string, even when rooted in a match expression. A literal-string sep makes default irrelevant, so ignored values and intentional failures do not change splitting or joining.
